resolution.conclusion: E8 One is configurable. Per-option values (drawdown -> target / daily): 4 -> 6 / 3; 6 -> 9 / 4; 8 -> 12 / 5.3; 10 -> 15 / 6.6; 14 -> 21 / 9.2. Configurator code: daily multiplier 0.66 except 0.75 at the 4% option (i=y=>y===4?.75:g), rounded to 0.1 (k=_=>Math.round(_*10)/10). Priced default 6% -> 9% / 4% / 6% (stored). Help article 11775980 describes the 4% option.
resolution.correction: Earlier today the note implied 0.66x for every option (2.64% at 4%); the configurator uses 0.75x at 4% (= 3%), matching the help article.
